Europe Experiences Record-Breaking Heatwave, Disrupting Events and Services

A severe heatwave has caused record-breaking temperatures across Europe, impacting several countries including the UK, Germany, Denmark, Switzerland, and the Czech Republic. The extreme heat has strained emergency services and hospitals, leading to the postponement of events like the Paris Pride parade. Scientists are exploring potential links between the heatwave and an ocean 'cold blob'.
